title: SIAM UQ 2026
text:
Abstract
Randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods combine the variance reduction properties of quasi-Monte Carlo with the statistical error estimation capabilities of Monte Carlo methods.
These techniques have become an important tool for high-dimensional numerical integration and uncertainty quantification.
This talk discusses theoretical foundations and practical implementation of RQMC methods together with examples from recent applications.
